taxonomy: Twelve overlapping comparison lenses, non-exhaustive and not twelve active engines

lenses.label: Biology / organisms
lenses.limit: chirality and sequence; experiments require actual biological evidence

lenses.label: Chemistry / materials
lenses.limit: molecular mirror/enantio relations; stereochemistry not operational undo

lenses.label: Physical / device / world
lenses.limit: timestamped machine telemetry; offline observer is not powered-off host

lenses.label: Digital / software / CI
lenses.limit: exact revisions, tests, build, failure propagation, receiver readproof

lenses.label: Natural / code / math / music / visual / social languages
lenses.limit: translation with declared grammar, ambiguity and loss

lenses.label: Images / diagrams / spatial UI
lenses.limit: CoOrb, CoMap and CoBar project one typed source state

lenses.label: Audio / voice / music / silence
lenses.limit: caption, quiet mode and consent; left/right stereo is not chirality

lenses.label: History / present / future
lenses.limit: immutable originals, currentness and forecast marked as forecast

lenses.label: Energy / computation / attention
lenses.limit: finite leases and outcome per cost, not perpetual work

lenses.label: Cultural / ethical / spiritual lenses
lenses.limit: participant-authored meanings, not physical proof or authority

CoNAGI.role: Challenge unsafe or net-negative candidate; keep reason and counterevidence
CoNAGI.not: automatic permanent ban or blind -1 valence

CoInvx.role: Type-check converse, negation, mirror, backtrace, true inverse, compensation, alternative
CoInvx.not: auto-flipping signs or claiming lossy transforms invertible

CoNunChuck.role: Typed two-endpoint edge with provenance, predicate and optional reverse traversal

CoHandedness.role: Explicit orientation in a scoped coordinate, syntax or stereochemical convention
CoHandedness.not: equating R/S, L/D, stereo channels, motor handedness or left/right brain

CoSeedCloud.role: Lazy discoverable adjacent candidate graph, only materializing elected tasks
CoSeedCloud.not: always-on arbitrary fan-out, self-replicating agents or unbounded expense

CoValence.role: Context- and receiver-relative compatibility hypothesis with measured evidence
CoValence.not: physical chemical valence, fixed +/− values or authority grant

GluKeyEek.role: Candidate glue/key/backtrace from source RAW to tested reusable relation
GluKeyEek.not: formal inverse of lossy RAW, replacement of original or disclosure right

owner_boundaries.CoNexus: eligible relation match, no invented delivery
owner_boundaries.CoOrb: receiver-specific views, not additional truth store
owner_boundaries.CoTurtle: bounded challenges, aggregate budget and stop
owner_boundaries.CoOmniPie: independent comparisons and holdouts, not cherry-picked samples

nonclaims: A draft branch is not a public release or a receiver ACK
No proof all twelve lenses are active
No universal broadcasting or historical rewriting
Rich media is an optional encoding, not the underlying physical substrate
No discovery of chemical/biological chirality mechanisms or AI consciousness
